# Who Owns a Runway Image? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-tofr-08422
Voiceover: The image is a distinct authored work around fashion; the clothes, staging, model, commission, publication, and photograph do not collapse into one ownership question.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Toni Frissell Collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — CO03-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · AUTHOR — Who made the photograph?. Record the photographer, capture date and time, file origin, embedded metadata, assignment, employer, commissioning party, and whether a statutory work-made-for-hire theory is actually supported. Payment alone is not the test.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO03-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · TRANSFER — Did ownership or an exclusive right move?. Locate the signed writing, identify the rights transferred, territory, media, duration, exclusivity, sublicensing, credit, editing, archive, and termination terms. A delivery folder, invoice, or social post may be relevant evidence but is not automatically a complete transfer instrument.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO03-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · PERMISSION STACK — What else governs use?. Separate copyright from accreditation terms, publication license, model agreement, venue rules, embargo, trademark presentation, publicity or privacy law, and contractual restrictions. The answer may change with use, territory, and audience.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO03-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · PUBLISH — Can the exact use be shown?. Before publishing, bind the exact image or clip to its source record, permitted use, crop or edit, credit, caption, alt text, license evidence, expiration, takedown route, and counsel decision where the stack remains uncertain.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S53
Voiceover: 17 U.S.C. § 101 — Definitions is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: U.S. House Office of the Law Revision Counsel

Rights: U.S. statutory text; quote narrowly and link.
